title: Recover deleted collection data
instructions: A bulk update deleted the asset records. Inspect the backup list and verify that the current collection is empty. Restore the incident backup. Read assets_lookup and verify asset-1 and asset-2 are present. Confirm the automatic pre-restore safety snapshot appears. Close the incident with the selected archive and validation evidence. This model backs up data; collection definitions must already exist.
completionScope: KV checks validate persisted collection contents, service health and recovery outcomes. Review your explanation separately.
